user.title: Add a virtual controller
user.description: Pick the controller: a MicroGEM60, or a GEM 80 compact controller (100C, 100CE, 130C or 130CE) with its memory size. The I/O comes next. Inputs become switches, outputs become binary sensors, and the controller gets its own front panel in the sidebar.

data_description.model: The memory size sets how long a program can be and how big the data tables are. A 130C has more Special Functions than a 100C; an E model keeps its program and P table in EPROM.

expansions.title: Expansion units
expansions.description: A MicroGEM60 has 12 inputs and 8 relay outputs. Each expansion unit adds 12 inputs and 8 outputs (up to 7, for 160 I/O in all).

data_description.expansions: 0 to 7. Expansion unit 1 uses A1 and B1, unit 2 uses A2 and B2, and so on. You can change this later.

modules.title: I/O modules
modules.description: The {model} subrack has eight slots for Compact I/O modules. Each slot has two words of the A table (inputs) and of the B table (outputs): slot 1 has A0 and A1 or B0 and B1, slot 2 the next two, and so on. You can change the modules later.

data_description.slot_1: Inputs on A0 and A1, outputs on B0 and B1.
data_description.slot_2: Inputs on A2 and A3, outputs on B2 and B3.
data_description.slot_3: Inputs on A4 and A5, outputs on B4 and B5.
data_description.slot_4: Inputs on A6 and A7, outputs on B6 and B7.
data_description.slot_5: Inputs on A8 and A9, outputs on B8 and B9.
data_description.slot_6: Inputs on A10 and A11, outputs on B10 and B11.
data_description.slot_7: Inputs on A12 and A13, outputs on B12 and B13.
data_description.slot_8: Inputs on A14 and A15, outputs on B14 and B15.

load_program.name: Load program
load_program.description: Replaces the ladder program on a virtual MicroGEM or GEM 80. The old program is kept if the new one has a mistake.

program.name: Program
program.description: One rung per line, for example: A0.0 AND NOT A0.1 -> B0.0

init.title: Expansion units
init.description: Each expansion unit adds 12 inputs and 8 relay outputs on the next A and B words. Removing a unit removes its entities.

modules.title: Controller and I/O modules
modules.description: Change the memory size or the module in each slot. A terminal whose address changes gets a new entity, and loses its field wiring. If the program no longer fits, or uses a Special Function the controller lacks, the example program is loaded instead.

data_description.slot_2: Inputs on A2 and A3, outputs on B2 and B3.
